name: Waki (Japan)
description: A brown field charged at the centre with the Waki town emblem in white: a ring crossed by a vertical bar and horizontal bars, like the character 和.
history: Municipal flag of Waki, a town in Yamaguchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1953.

features.role: Waki town emblem — a ring crossed by a vertical bar and horizontal bars, like the character 和
